judge.selected_on: VALIDATION paper-protocol F1 (Agent-ICL 0.922, probability 0.862, binary 0.788); user decision 2026-11-02

test_reuse_disclosure: The 528 paper test sequences were each scored once for three published prompts in the Phase 2 replication (no tuning on them). Phase 3 reuses them for new history conditions; any claim must state this.

protocol.first_turn: not scored in any condition (paper protocol)
protocol.only_changed_input: which earlier steps the judge sees; template, parsing, decoding identical
protocol.presentation: selected earlier steps in chronological order, then the current request
protocol.threshold: per condition, most sensitive threshold with validation sequence FPR <= budget (>= firing rule)

primary_metric: timely recall on test at the frozen validation threshold
secondary_metrics: share of decisions whose history is shorter than full
primary_k_rationale: At k=5 most decisions already see all earlier steps (median sequence ~7 steps), so k=3 is the stronger test of selection. To be confirmed with the margin before any test run.

primary_comparisons.question: Does top-k retrieval keep full-history timely recall within the margin?
Do retrievers beat recency at the same k?

margin_rule: Set after the validation stage, before any test run, from validation results only; recorded in the frozen thresholds file.
statistics: paired sequence bootstrap on identical test IDs, 2000 draws, seed 1729; sequence-level (not task-family); report counts and denominators
exploratory: paper F1/DSR at the same scores
not_in_phase3: oracle evidence and ablations (Phase 4); response-aware evidence (E2)
